hero.subtitle: EnergyMonitor was born so any household can see, understand, and control its electricity use, without the hassle.

problem.title: The problem
problem.description: Many people don't know how their electricity is really being used, which leads to higher-than-expected bills and a negative environmental impact.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Record, process, and analyze consumption in real time, with alerts and personalized recommendations, so everyone can decide before the bill arrives.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: A world where saving energy is as simple as opening an app and seeing exactly what's using too much.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: We show the data as it is, without averages that hide what matters.

saving.title: Real savings
saving.description: Every alert and recommendation aims for a measurable impact on your bill.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Less unnecessary consumption also means a smaller environmental footprint.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.description: Energy is already complex; monitoring it shouldn't be.

how.title: How do we make it possible?
how.description: Each appliance connects through a current sensor and an ESP32 microcontroller installed in the outlet. That data is processed and turned into charts, alerts, and recommendations that are easy to understand, available in both the mobile app and the web platform.

reduction.label: average reduction from consumption caught in time

coverage.label: of your devices, monitored from one place

team.title: The team behind EnergyMonitor
team.subtitle: Two people built the whole system: from the sensor wired to the ESP32 to the app you use today.

1.name: Juan Esteban Cortez Parra
1.functions: Coordinates the project and validates progress, while leading backend development, APIs, cloud integration, and system testing.

2.name: Miguel Ángel García Artunduaga
2.functions: Gathers and documents requirements, designs the interface and clickable prototypes, and leads frontend development and usability testing.

cta.subtitle: Create your free account and start monitoring your devices today.
